messages:
maria: Quick design review — pushed a v2 of the Run Inspector (structured output + tool calls). Main changes: history entries collapsed, expandable per-invocation tool list, inline JSON-schema diffs for outputs. Screenshot + prototype: https://staging.redwood.dev/playground/run-inspector

alex: Nice. One question: how does keyboard navigation work for the collapsed entries? Need arrow + enter/space to expand, and a clear focus target. Also we should expose `k` / `j` shortcuts for next/prev run.

jamal: Performance note: for accounts with long run history we can't render diffs for every entry. Suggest virtualization + lazy-load diffs when expanded. Maybe keep a lightweight placeholder with a tiny summary until expanded.

maria: Agreed on lazy-load. Current plan: only load full diff when expanded, otherwise show a 1-line summary (tool names + status). Also thinking of server-side precompute of small diffs for recent runs.

sana: Copy nits: - "Tool output" feels generic, prefer "Tool result". - "Invocation" is a bit jargon-y; prefer "Run" or "Execution" depending on context. - Button text: "Download" -> "Export JSONL" when exporting multiple runs. - Tooltip on the schema-diff toggle should read: "Show field-level changes between outputs".

olivia: Accessibility nits: - Make expand/collapse buttons `button` elements with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. - Use `aria-live=\"polite\"` on the diff container so screen readers announce when content loads. - Ensure diff colors meet contrast (green -> use blue/gray combos). - Focus ring must move into the expanded panel; add a skip link for keyboard users to jump to the diff.

alex: For keyboard mapping: propose this set 
```
k: previous run
j: next run
Enter/Space: toggle expand
D: open export modal
```
Also add a small help overlay (shift+/) listing shortcuts.

jamal: Implementation detail: diffs can be heavy. I'll prototype lazy-loading with a spinner and a small cached summary payload in the list item (delta size, changed keys count). We'll also experiment with streaming diffs so UI shows incremental changes.

maria: UX question — how visible should tool-call outputs be in the collapsed state? Right now we only show tool names + status + a 1-line excerpt for the topmost tool. Thoughts?

sana: I think 1-line excerpt works, but highlight if a tool raises an error (red pill) and surface a quick "View error" CTA inline. Keep clutter low.

olivia: Also add an accessible "Copy JSON" action per-invocation with `aria-label=\"Copy output JSON for run X\"`. Avoid relying on icon-only buttons for primary actions.

maria: Good. Action items: @alex add keyboard mapping & help overlay; @jamal benchmark lazy-load & streaming; @sana finalize copy strings; @olivia add ARIA annotations and contrast checks. I'll update the prototype and re-deploy to staging. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Design preview deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.dev/playground/run-inspector v2 — build 2026-03-23T15:02Z

maria: Thanks! I'll schedule a quick QA session tomorrow 10:30am PT to run through keyboard/aria flows. If anyone wants to join, ping me.

olivia: I'll join for accessibility checks.

alex: I'll add the shortcut help overlay PR today.

jamal: Will run perf tests after lunch and post numbers in this thread.
